briefing.headline: AMD surges 5.96% amid broad tech gains
briefing.summary: Mega-cap tech tokens such as AMD (+5.96%) and NVDA (+3.40%) led the upside, while the broader core basket showed modest positive average (+1.42%). Defensive chips like SPY (+0.72%) and QQQ (+1.64%) also nudged higher, but several small-cap and leveraged names fell sharply, e.g., BV (-16.31%) and SOXS (-14.59%). Overall market breadth was positive with 7 advancers versus 3 decliners among the core ten, suggesting a cautiously risk-on tone ahead of the US open.
